description: This file contains utility functions for loading and processing TGA image files, including reading TGA headers, loading image data, and creating OpenGL textures from TGA images.

classes.name: TGAImage
classes.description: Class representing a TGA image with width, height, and pixel data.

methods.name: LoadTGAImageFromFile
methods.description: Loads a TGA image from a file into a TGAImage object.

methods.name: LoadTextureFromTGAImage
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL texture from a TGAImage object.
